body.name: Exact rational finite-orbit certificate
body.construction: Restrict each orbit decision \(\delta(r,x)\) to a mixture over \(\Gamma_M\), linearize the resulting squared risks with nonnegative joint design--action weights, and minimize their common upper bound over the design-orbit law for \(\Lambda_{n,M}^{\mathrm{all}}\), or fix the multinomial \(q\)-law for \(\Lambda_{n,M}^{\mathrm{iid}}(q)\).
